title: agent_framework API: Role is NewType(str), use string role literals
description: In agent-framework 0.0.0, Role imported from agent_framework is typing.NewType('Role', str), NOT an enum. Message(role, contents) takes a RoleLiteral string: 'system'|'user'|'assistant'|'tool'. Do NOT use Role.USER/.ASSISTANT. Content.from_text()/from_uri() build parts; ChatOptions is a dict accepting response_format/seed/temperature/max_tokens. FoundryChatClient(project_endpoint=,model=,credential=).

title: Python tooling is uv (Python 3.13); verified build/test commands
description: Dependencies live in src/containerapp/pyproject.toml + uv.lock (no requirements.txt). Setup: 'uv sync' in src/containerapp. Tests MUST run from repo root: 'uv run --project src/containerapp pytest src/evaluators/tests' (the tests use 'from src.evaluators...' which only resolves as a namespace package from repo root). Docker: multi-stage python:3.13-slim using 'uv sync --frozen'. CI uses astral-sh/setup-uv@v5.

title: LLM orchestration goes through ai_ocr/agents (Microsoft Agent Framework)
description: All LLM calls must use the shared agents layer (run_chat / run_chat_sync) in src/containerapp/ai_ocr/agents/, never openai.AzureOpenAI directly. Primary client is FoundryChatClient (Azure AI Foundry project endpoint AZURE_AI_PROJECT_ENDPOINT); falls back to OpenAIChatClient when no project endpoint is set. Auth is passwordless (DefaultAzureCredential / managed identity). client.py bridges async Agent Framework to sync worker threads via a persistent background event loop.

title: ARGUS deploys to Azure via azd up (Foundry, eastus2)
description: Verified deploy: azd env needs AZURE_ENV_NAME, AZURE_LOCATION (eastus2: gpt-5.4 v2026-03-05 GlobalStandard available, quota ok), AZURE_PRINCIPAL_ID (signed-in user object id), AZURE_OPENAI_MODEL_DEPLOYMENT_NAME=gpt-5.4. Bicep fix: model deployment must dependsOn the Foundry project (both are account children; parallel create caused IfMatchPreconditionFailed). API_KEY is a deterministic KV secret (uniqueString); KV is private, read live value via: az containerapp exec -n ca-argus -g rg-argus-dev --command 'printenv API_KEY'. Container Apps have external ingress; backend:8000 frontend:3000.

title: Verbose Azure SDK HTTP INFO logging floods Container App logs
description: azure.core.pipeline.policies.http_logging_policy logs full request/response headers at INFO, drowning app logs and making diagnosis hard. Consider setting logging level for azure.* loggers to WARNING in the app startup.

title: Pre-existing repo-wide ruff lint debt (~1292 E/W/F/S errors)
description: The CI lint job runs 'ruff check src/ --select=E,W,F,S' and fails on ~1292 pre-existing errors (mostly W293 trailing-whitespace blank lines, E501 long lines, S101 asserts in tests). This predates the Agent Framework/Foundry/uv modernization (lint rule unchanged). New/modernized code is ruff-F clean. Follow-up: decide whether to bulk-autofix (ruff --fix) or relax the select set.
